req.title: Create task
req.statement: The system shall create a new task and respond with HTTP 201 and the created task body when POST /tasks/ receives a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected_outcomes: response body includes id, title, completed=false

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'Create task' functionality of the task management API. It includes a positive test to ensure a task is created successfully, a negative test to handle invalid input, and a boundary test to check the minimum title length. These tests ensure the API behaves correctly under normal, erroneous, and edge conditions.

tests.name: test_create_task_success
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected: Response body includes id, title, completed=false.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "A new task description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["title"] == "New Task"
assert response_data["completed"] is False
assert "id" in response_data

tests.name: test_create_task_invalid_payload
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an invalid TaskCreate payload (missing title).
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"description": "A new task description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a TaskCreate payload where title is exactly 1 character long.
expected: Response body includes id, title, completed=false.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "A", "description": "Boundary test for title length", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["title"] == "A"
assert response_data["completed"] is False
assert "id" in response_data
